h1: Custom Black Blankets for Events & Promotions
metaDescription: Order custom black blankets for your next event. Perfect for corporate gifts, outdoor promotions, and employee rewards. Bulk pricing available.
introHtml: Black blankets are a versatile choice for corporate gifts, event giveaways, and employee rewards. They hide dirt well, making them ideal for outdoor use at picnics, sporting events, or camping trips. Choose from sherpa, fleece, or picnic blanket styles, all customizable with your logo via screen printing or embroidery. A practical promotional item your recipients will actually use.
heroAltText: Custom black blankets with embroidered logo, including sherpa and fleece styles for corporate gifts
